chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from a sheikh, who raised the hadith to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
He said to him: 'O so-and-so! Reduce the expenditure in the Hajj so that you will be eager for the Hajj, and do not increase the expenditure in the Hajj so that you will become weary of it.'
ai.seo_question: How does the amount of money spent affect one's spiritual experience during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises minimizing financial expenditure during Hajj to preserve spiritual enthusiasm and prevent weariness, highlighting the Shia emphasis on moderation (wasatiyyah) in worship. This guidance ensures that the pilgrimage remains a source of spiritual renewal rather than a burden of material excess, aligning with the principle that ease facilitates consistent devotion.
